caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture resembling a desk or vanity, positioned centrally within a rectangular border on a plain, off-white background. The desk is supported by four carved, reddish-brown legs, each featuring detailed contours and tapered ends. The main body of the desk consists of a rectangular structure with an array of drawers: three smaller drawers aligned horizontally at the top center, flanked on each side by slightly larger drawers, and additional drawers beneath. Two vertical panels with hinge marks are situated toward the back corners of the desktop, possibly for holding writing or drawing materials. The back of the desk rises into a low, solid wooden backrest with a wood grain pattern, and two side blocks are attached to this backrest. The wood is depicted in various tones of brown, with lighter streaks and swirls indicating a natural wood grain. The perspective and shadows suggest lighting coming from the upper left.
title: Melodeon Converted into Desk
